notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2022-01-21) by Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NZF, Acquiring Fund) for the reorganization of Nuveen Enhanced Municipal Value Fund (NEV, Target Fund) into NZF: NEV transfers substantially all assets and liabilities to NZF for newly issued NZF common shares, then liquidates. NEV common shareholders vote (at NEV's annual meeting, which also elects four Class I board members); NZF preferred shareholders (MFP and VRDP) vote as a single class; no new preferred shares are issued. Meeting date, record date and the expected closing date are [●] placeholders in this preliminary filing ('expected to take effect on or about [●], 2022'), so meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are null. The exchange is at relative NAV as of the close of trading on the business day before closing; no fixed ratio and no illustrative ratio were read. Cash only in lieu of fractional shares. No collar. The plan of reorganization states no outside date: Section 11.1 allows termination by mutual agreement, for uncured breach, for an unmeetable condition, or by a board determination that the transaction is not in its fund's best interests (that board-discretion right is a termination right, not listed as a closing condition). 'other' condition covers third-party consents (preferred holders, liquidity providers incl. for Series 3 VRDP Shares), officers' certificates, legal opinions of Vedder Price / Morgan Lewis (Sections 8.6-8.7) and the Section 8.5 pre-closing distribution of the Target Fund's investment company taxable income and net capital gains (could also be read as ric_or_tax_status; not listed separately). Shareholder approval (8.1) and the tax opinion (8.8) are stated as non-waivable.
